title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]

## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you would like to see.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a specific problem or workflow? (e.g. "I am always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution / Design
Describe the solution you'd like. Include any proposed CLI commands, API signatures, or UI workflows if applicable.

## Native Acceleration / Architectural Considerations
Will this feature benefit from Rust computational acceleration in `schemasense_core` or should it reside purely in Python?

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or architectural diagrams about the feature request here.
